title: MIB Studio gold-standard processing metrics
description: Uniform JSON format for per-object deformability-cytometry metrics, used to compare mib-studio-qt pipeline output against the MIB-Studio legacy pipeline and against any portable reimplementation of the pipeline (see docs/gold_standard_metrics.md). Field names align with FilterResult and BrightnessQuantiles in include/backend/processing/ProcessingService.h.

version.description: Schema version of this metrics document.

pixel_to_micron.description: Conversion factor: 1 pixel = pixel_to_micron microns. Required to derive area_um2 from area.

source.description: Optional label identifying the producer, e.g. 'mib-studio-qt', 'MIB-Studio-gold'.

frame_type.description: Whether the source frame/ROI passed validation.

object_id.description: One-based object candidate within the source frame/ROI, ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom; -1 when no object candidate was selected.

object_count.description: Number of object candidates emitted for the source frame/ROI.

area_um2.description: Area in um^2 = area * pixel_to_micron^2. Optional; derivable from area and pixel_to_micron.

youngs_modulus.description: Young's modulus (kPa) from EModulusLut bilinear lookup on (area_um, deformability). Optional: omitted when the query point falls outside LUT coverage (lookup returns NaN) or when the producer has no LUT loaded (e.g. a legacy CSV conversion).

ring_ratio.description: sqrt(outer_area - inner_area); ring metric used for focus feedback.

is_valid.description: True if frame passed all validation checks.

touches_border.description: True if the contour touches the image border.

has_single_inner_contour.description: True only when there is exactly one inner contour. Informational; acceptance uses at least one nested contour.

in_range.description: True if area is within the configured min/max range.

brightness_q1.description: 25th percentile brightness in the masked region.
